bowling.description: Do not recommend a defensive field if a wicket recently fell. You must keep the pressure on the new batter with an attacking field.
Do not recommend changing the bowler if they have bowled fewer than 2 overs (min spell rule), unless economy signal is extreme.
Spinners cannot bowl off or leg cutters.

batting.description: Do not recommend aggressive acceleration for a batter who has faced very few balls (still assessing the pitch).
Do not recommend pure defense in death overs if the required run rate is far above the projected rate.
